title: ForgeWorld Phone Sensor Mission (Ascension v1)
description: Lightweight mission object captured on the phone-side sensory cortex. Distinct from, and lower-weight than, schema/mission.schema.json (the full desktop mission format produced later in the lifecycle). A sensor mission is promoted into a desktop mission via scripts/promote-sensor-mission.sh, which carries these fields into the richer format without losing them. This schema may evolve additively over time; unknown future fields must not break existing readers.

mission_id.description: Phone Sensor Mission ID. Namespaced PSM- so it can never collide with desktop MSN- ids.

observation.description: What was actually observed, in the operator's words.

evidence.description: Description of, or reference to, the supporting evidence.

location.description: Optional. Free-text place/context, not raw GPS - keeps this offline and privacy-light by default.

capability_contribution.description: What reusable capability this mission is expected to strengthen (Primary Law). Never empty - use 'unknown' if not yet determined.

content_hash.description: sha256 of objective+observation+context, used for duplicate detection.
